mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pending_action(id, idempotency_key, user_id, conversation_id, tool_name, arguments, arguments_hash, summary, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{key}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{toolName}, #{arguments}, #{hash}, #{summary}, 'PENDING') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO pending_action(id, idempotency_key, user_id, conversation_id, tool_name, arguments, arguments_hash, summary, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{key}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{toolName}, #{arguments}, #{hash}, #{summary}, 'PENDING') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT id, idempotency_key, user_id, conversation_id, tool_name, arguments, arguments_hash, summary, status, COALESCE(result, '{}') AS result_json, version, created_at FROM pending_action WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, idempotency_key, user_id, conversation_id, tool_name, arguments, arguments_hash, summary, status, COALESCE(result, '{}') AS result_json, version, created_at FROM pending_action WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pending_action SET status = #{status}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING'
